name: comments
description: Google-Docs-style review for markdown in the terminal — inline comment threads, suggestions, review gates, and RPI phase templates for human-agent doc collaboration.

plugins.name: comments
plugins.description: Review workflow for agent-written docs: the review-comments skill (one-comment-at-a-time loop, RPI research/plan phases) plus the comments MCP server (20 tools: threads, suggestions, review gate, templates, watch-for-signoff). Requires the comments binary on PATH: go install github.com/rcliao/comments/cmd/comments@latest
